disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false or fraudulent return attempting to defeat or evade the tax
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Makes any false or fraudulent return in attempting to defeat or evade the tax imposed by this chapter is guilty of a Class 6 felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay tax due within sixty days from the date it becomes due
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to pay tax due under this chapter within sixty days from the date the tax becomes due is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep required records and books or refusing to exhibit them to the secretary of revenue
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to keep the records and books required by §10-45-45 or refuses to exhibit these records to the secretary of revenue or the secretary's agents for the purpose of examination is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to file a required return within sixty days from the date it is due
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fails to file a return required by this chapter within sixty days from the date the return is due is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business without obtaining a contractor's excise tax license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in business under this chapter without obtaining a contractor's excise tax license is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business after the contractor's excise tax license has been revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in business under this chapter after the person's contractor's excise tax license has been revoked by the secretary of revenue is guilty of a Class 6 felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the failure-to-pay or failure-to-file provisions two or more times in any twelve-month period
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violates either subdivision (2) or subdivision (4) of this section two or more times in any twelve-month period is guilty of a Class 6 felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business without a license after being notified in writing by the secretary of revenue of the requirement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engages in business under this chapter without obtaining a contractor's excise tax license after having been notified in writing by the secretary of revenue that the person is a contractor subject to the provisions of the contractors' excise tax laws is guilty of a Class 6 felony

bonding_required.quote: the corporation, limited liability company, limited partnership, limited liability partnership, or limited liability limited partnership shall provide the Department of Revenue with a surety bond or certificate of deposit as security for payment of any tax that may become due

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
